name: formpath
description: Draw in formpath, the vector illustration editor, in plain language: paths, shapes, type, paint, effects, layers, artboards and export.
long_description: Connects Claude Desktop to formpath running on this computer. Start formpath first (the desktop app, or ./formpath boot); this extension never starts it. Until formpath answers, only a ping tool is offered, and the full tool list appears once it does. Every change is one undoable step, and the first one asks you, in the formpath window, to allow outside agents.

engine_url.title: formpath engine address
engine_url.description: Where the formpath engine listens. The default suits a formpath started on this computer.
